title: Koru Raw Manifest
description: Written by every source module as manifest.json next to the artifacts it fetched. It is the output contract of the source stage and the input contract of the processing stage.

capture_id.description: Identifier of this capture. Becomes the dataset id after processing.

provider.description: Upstream the data came from, e.g. 'openstreetmap' or the game's slug.

offline.description: True when the capture was replayed from recorded fixtures (KORU_OFFLINE=1) instead of fetched live.

params.description: Request parameters that produced this capture (bbox, region, map or save name, ...).

crs.description: CRS of the raw artifacts as reported by the source.

path.description: Path relative to the directory holding manifest.json.

role.description: How processing should treat the artifact.
